name: Fighting
desc: Base combat skill. Trained by any combat. Each level adds +1% damage.

name: Swordsmanship
desc: Sword skill. Manifests at Fighting 10 with a sword equipped; trained by sword combat. Each level adds +1.5% damage and +0.2% crit while a sword is equipped.

name: Scouting
desc: Trained by exploring and travelling. Each level adds +1% travel speed and +0.5% loot.

name: Chronosense
desc: Trained by elapsed game time only; no action raises it. Levels unlock time readings in order: time of day, season, hour, week, minute. Capped at 20 until the cap is raised; levels past the cap reduce time-based penalties.

name: Hunting
desc: Trained by kills; the first kill of a new species pays most, and new bestiary entries pay outright. Each level adds +0.4% loot and +0.3% gold gain, raises the per-kill chance of learning a bestiary fact, and lowers the sightings needed to confirm a habitat.

name: Speechcraft
desc: Trained by dialogue and by quests; a new person pays most, and turning work in pays more than accepting it. Manifests the first time you take work from a stranger. Each level adds +0.5% gold gain.

name: Musicianship
desc: Trained by performing; manifests on the first performance. Levels unlock notation: quarter notes at 5, eighth notes at 12, other scales at 20, 8-bar forms at 30. A piece is classified by what it measures as, not by what you intended.

name: Magic
desc: Base magic skill. Manifests at Intelligence 15; trained by casting. Each level adds +2% spell power.

name: Arcana
desc: Arcane spellcraft. Manifests at Intelligence 10 by working at the spell table; trained by composing new sentences, not by repeating old ones. Word order changes what a sentence does. Each level adds +1% spell power.

name: Devotion
desc: Divine spellcraft. Manifests at Wisdom 10 by working at the spell table. Miracles are granted by a deity, not composed. Each level adds +0.5 max spirit.

name: Psionics
desc: Psionic spellcraft. Manifests at Intelligence 12 and Wisdom 12 by working at the spell table. Levels buy more points to allocate and add +0.01 focus regeneration each.

name: Darkvision
desc: Trained only by standing in natural darkness away from lamplight. Each level removes 2% of the darkness penalty to hit chance and dodge; the penalty is gone at level 50, which is the cap.

name: Weathersense
desc: Trained by standing in weather and by arriving somewhere by travel; manifests in the first severe weather met outdoors. New weather kinds and new regions pay most. Levels unlock forecast rows: 2 hours at level 1, tomorrow at 5, out to 7 days at 29; each row starts rough and sharpens with levels past its unlock. Capped at 30.

name: Heat Resistance
desc: Trained by taking heat damage. Each level cuts heat damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Cold Resistance
desc: Trained by taking cold damage. Each level cuts cold damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Poison Resistance
desc: Trained by taking poison damage. Each level cuts poison damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Water Resistance
desc: Trained by taking water damage, including from rain. Each level cuts water damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Wind Resistance
desc: Trained by taking wind damage, including from weather. Each level cuts wind damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Earth Resistance
desc: Trained by taking earth damage, including from sandstorms. Each level cuts earth damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Lightning Resistance
desc: Trained by taking lightning damage, including from storms. Each level cuts lightning damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Light Resistance
desc: Trained by taking light damage, including glare and holy light. Each level cuts light damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Dark Resistance
desc: Trained by taking dark damage. Each level cuts dark damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%. Seeing in darkness is Darkvision, not this.

name: Arcane Resistance
desc: Trained by taking arcane damage. Each level cuts arcane damage taken by 1%, 3% every 5th level, 5% every 10th, 10% every 25th; the resistance caps at 75%.

name: Smithing
desc: Trained by smithing. Each level adds +1% craft speed, plus a step bonus every 5 levels.

name: Woodcutting
desc: Trained at woodcutting sites. Each level adds +1% loot, plus a step bonus every 5 levels.

name: Mining
desc: Trained at mining sites. Each level adds +1% loot, plus a step bonus every 5 levels.

name: Herbalism
desc: Trained at herb-gathering sites. Each level adds +1% loot, plus a step bonus every 5 levels. Herbalism 3 unlocks Alchemy.

name: Cooking
desc: Trained by cooking, and a dish new to you pays most. Each level adds +0.8% craft speed. Food you eat lasts 6% longer every 10 levels and hits 5% harder every 20, up to +50% each (Duration at level 90, Potency at 200).

name: Alchemy
desc: Manifests at Herbalism 3; trained by brewing. Levels buy sequence length (2 steps to 6, at levels 5, 12, 22 and 35) and reagent vocabulary, never brew quality; quality comes from the sequence. Each level adds +0.6% craft speed.

name: Geneshaping
desc: Unlocked by quest; trained by geneshaping, and a new gene pays most. Levels raise what a carcass yields and how far a bench can push a grade. Each level adds +0.6% craft speed.

name: Runecarving
desc: Trained at the rune table. Each level adds +1% craft speed, plus a step bonus every 5 levels.

name: Unarmed Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 3 while unarmed; trained by unarmed combat. Each level adds +2% damage and +0.5% attack speed while unarmed.

name: Dagger Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 3 with a dagger equipped; trained by dagger combat. Each level adds +0.3% crit and +1.2% damage while a dagger is equipped.

name: Staff Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 3 with a staff equipped; trained by staff combat. Each level adds +1% damage and +1.2% spell power while a staff is equipped.

name: Club Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 3 with a blunt weapon equipped; trained by blunt combat. Each level adds +1.6% damage and +0.05 armor while a blunt weapon is equipped.

name: Greatsword Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 8 with a greatsword equipped; trained by greatsword combat. Each level adds +1.8% damage and +0.15% crit while a greatsword is equipped.

name: Spear Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 8 with a spear equipped; trained by spear combat. Each level adds +1.8% attack speed and +0.15% crit while a spear is equipped.

name: Bow Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 3 with a bow equipped; trained by bow combat. Each level adds +0.2% crit, +0.2% dodge and +1% damage while a bow is equipped.

name: Deflection
desc: Manifests at Fighting 5 with a parrying item equipped (parrying dagger, buckler, rapier); any fight while carrying one trains it, in any stance. Each level adds +0.2% parry and +0.6% riposte while one is equipped.

name: Ittou-ryu
desc: Katana school. Manifests by fighting in the Quick stance with a katana at Swordsmanship 25 and Dexterity 20; replaces Quick with Ittou-ryu. In that style with a katana: +5% crit and +5% damage, plus +0.4% crit and +2% damage per level.

name: Jigen-ryu

tierNames.name: The First Strike Is the Last

desc: Katana school. Manifests by fighting in the Crush stance with a katana at Swordsmanship 15 and Strength 30; replaces Crush with Jigen-ryu. Each level adds +0.5% damage in that style.

name: Niten-Ichi-ryu
desc: Katana school. Manifests by fighting in the Flurry stance with a katana at Swordsmanship 25 and Dexterity 35; replaces Flurry with Niten-Ichi-ryu. Each level adds +0.15% parry and +0.4% riposte in that style.

name: Eishin-ryu
desc: Katana school. Manifests by fighting in the Finesse stance with a katana at Swordsmanship 20 and Dexterity 40; replaces Finesse with Eishin-ryu. Each level adds +0.15% crit in that style.

name: Destreza
desc: Rapier school. Manifests by fighting in the Evasive stance with a rapier at Swordsmanship 18, Deflection 10 and Dexterity 30; replaces Evasive with Destreza. Each level adds +0.2% parry and +0.8% riposte in that style.

name: Bolognese
desc: Sword-and-buckler school. Manifests by fighting in the Brace stance with a sword and a buckler at Shield Combat 15, Swordsmanship 12, Deflection 8 and Dexterity 20; replaces Brace with Bolognese. Each level adds +0.15% parry and +0.5% riposte in that style.

name: Magic Combat
desc: Spellblade school. Manifests by fighting in the Finesse stance at Fighting 10, Magic 10 and Intelligence 20; replaces Finesse with Magic Combat, whose exertion spends mana instead of stamina. Each level adds +0.8% damage in that style.

name: Boxing
desc: Unarmed school. Manifests by fighting in the Evasive stance while unarmed at Unarmed Combat 20, Strength 30 and Constitution 25; replaces Evasive with Boxing. Each level adds +0.3% attack speed and +0.1% dodge in that style.

name: Taekwondo
desc: Unarmed school. Manifests by fighting in the Flurry stance while unarmed at Unarmed Combat 25 and Dexterity 40; replaces Flurry with Taekwondo. Each level adds +0.15% dodge in that style.

name: Muay Thai
desc: Unarmed school. Manifests by fighting in the Crush stance while unarmed at Unarmed Combat 35, Strength 40 and Constitution 40; replaces Crush with Muay Thai. Each level adds +0.5% damage in that style.

name: Wrestling
desc: Unarmed school. Manifests by fighting in the Brace stance while unarmed at Unarmed Combat 20, Strength 40 and Charisma 30; replaces Brace with Wrestling. Each level adds +0.8 max HP in that style.

name: Shield Combat
desc: Manifests at Fighting 3 with a shield equipped; trained by fighting with one. Each level adds +2% armor and +1 max HP while a shield is equipped.

name: Leathercrafting
desc: Trained by leatherwork. Each level adds +1% craft speed for leatherwork only; other crafts are unaffected.

name: Capoeira
desc: Unarmed school. Manifests by fighting in the Flurry stance while unarmed at Unarmed Combat 25 and Dexterity 40, after 100 dodges; replaces the Quick stance with Capoeira. Each level adds +0.15% dodge in that style.

name: Eskrima
desc: Dagger school. Manifests at Dagger Combat 25 and Dexterity 30 with a dagger equipped. Grants no bonuses yet.
